title: Automate workflows using AI-enabled tools and standard procedures
description: Design and implement routine workflow automation using AI-enabled tools, rule-based logic, and repeatable procedures. Show how automation improves efficiency, reduces manual effort, and supports consistent output in operational software tasks.
soft_skills_description: Learners need to document procedures carefully, coordinate with users about workflow changes, and verify that automated steps follow the intended process.
rationale: These items form a clear competency because they all point to improving process efficiency through automation rather than building AI models themselves. The title uses an action verb and keeps the scope practical for vocational learners who need to implement and validate workflow improvements. Learners can demonstrate mastery by mapping a manual process, creating an automated version, and verifying that the result is reliable and repeatable. It is distinct from the AI/ML competency because the main outcome is operational automation, not model selection or prediction.
